notes: Volume: p1-3 introductory text, p4-33 'Elección de Diputados por comunas, departamentos y provincias' (each spread is a left page with 12 party columns and a right page with 8 more party columns plus totals; Varones/Mujeres/Total sub-columns; grouping totals only, Total sub-column), p34 summary by party, p35-42 parties without representation by commune, p43-44 fold-out tables (not used), p45-48 elected deputies by grouping, p49 typed national party totals, p50 seat chart. 28 contests: agrupaciones 1-26, with the 7th (Santiago) split into its three districts that each elect separately (numbers 71, 72, 73 = 7th agrupación, districts 1-3). 147 seats in all, matching p34. Only party votes are printed (no candidate votes); candidates hold the elected only. National = 'Total República' row (p32-33): valid 779.172, nulos y blancos 7.637, cast 785.609 (valid + null = 786.809, so the printed national row does not close), registered 1.100.027; national party figures sum to 779.183 (11 over printed valid). Pages are slightly skewed scans; boxes were measured on deskewed renders (rotation under 1.6 degrees), so they are approximate but contain the cited numbers.
